class.name: BiomeGenerator
class.brief_description: Biome system for terrain generation with height, temperature, humidity, and Y-range based layering.
class.description:
[b]BiomeGenerator[/b] determines terrain composition through biome-based voxel assignment. Biomes are region-based constraints defined by height, temperature, and humidity ranges that blend together smoothly.
[b]Key Features:[/b] [ul] [li]Multi-biome terrain with smooth blending transitions[/li] [li]Height-based sampling (beach, grassland, mountains, etc.)[/li] [li]Temperature and humidity noise for climate variety[/li] [li]Y-range based subsurface layering (new preferred method)[/li] [li]Deterministic voxel selection (reproducible results)[/li] [li]Sea level control for water biomes[/li] [/ul]
[b]Biome Concept:[/b] Each biome defines: - [b]Height range:[/b] Min/max altitude where biome appears - [b]Climate ranges:[/b] Temperature (-1 to 1) and humidity (-1 to 1) - [b]Surface blocks:[/b] What blocks appear at the surface - [b]Subsurface layers:[/b] Block types at specific Y ranges (new Y-range system) - [b]Bedrock/filler:[/b] Default blocks for bottom/fallback
When multiple biomes overlap, they blend smoothly over the blend_distance. Voxel selection is deterministic (seeded) to ensure reproducibility.
[b]Typical Usage:[/b] [code] var biome_gen = BiomeGenerator.new()
# Add grassland biome (height 5-15) biome_gen.add_biome_with_y_ranges( "grassland", # name 5.0, 15.0, # height range 0.4, 0.8, # temperature 0.4, 0.8, # humidity [1], # surface blocks (grass) [ # Y-range layers {\"min_y\": 0, \"max_y\": 3, \"blocks\": [2]}, # dirt layer {\"min_y\": -100, \"max_y\": 0, \"blocks\": [3]} # stone below ], 3, 3 # bedrock, filler )
# Add desert biome (hot, dry) biome_gen.add_biome_with_y_ranges( "desert", 2.0, 8.0, 0.8, 1.0, # very hot -1.0, 0.2, # dry [4], # sand [ {\"min_y\": 0, \"max_y\": 2, \"blocks\": [4]}, # sand {\"min_y\": -100, \"max_y\": 0, \"blocks\": [3]} # stone ], 3, 3 )
generator.set_biome_generator(biome_gen) [/code]
[b]Related Classes:[/b] [ul] [li][VoxelGenerator] - Uses biome generator for voxel assignment[/li] [li][NoiseGenerator] - Provides height, temperature, humidity sampling[/li] [li][FeatureGenerator] - Places features after biome terrain is set[/li] [li][Voxel] - Individual voxel representation with type data[/li] [/ul]

method.name: set_height_noise
method.description:
Sets the noise generator for height sampling (heightmap).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_noise[/code] - A [NoiseGenerator] that samples base terrain height.
[b]Effect:[/b] Used by all biomes to sample their base height at any world position.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var height_noise = NoiseGenerator.new() height_noise.set_period(128.0) height_noise.set_octaves(6) biome_gen.set_height_noise(height_noise) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_height_noise], [method set_temperature_noise], [method set_humidity_noise]

method.name: get_height_noise
method.description:
Returns the height noise generator.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_height_noise]

method.name: set_temperature_noise
method.description:
Sets the noise generator for temperature sampling.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_noise[/code] - A [NoiseGenerator] for climate variety.
[b]Effect:[/b] Samples temperature (-1 to 1) at terrain positions. Biomes with matching temperature ranges appear.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var temp_noise = NoiseGenerator.new() temp_noise.set_period(256.0) # Large-scale climate zones biome_gen.set_temperature_noise(temp_noise) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_temperature_noise], [method set_humidity_noise]

method.name: get_temperature_noise
method.description:
Returns the temperature noise generator.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_temperature_noise]

method.name: set_humidity_noise
method.description:
Sets the noise generator for humidity sampling.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_noise[/code] - A [NoiseGenerator] for humidity variety.
[b]Effect:[/b] Samples humidity (-1 to 1) for wet/dry zones.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_humidity_noise]

method.name: get_humidity_noise
method.description:
Returns the humidity noise generator.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_humidity_noise]

method.name: set_sea_level
method.description:
Sets the sea level (Y coordinate for water).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_sea_level[/code] - Y world coordinate. Terrain below this is water biome.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] biome_gen.set_sea_level(5.0) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_sea_level]

method.name: get_sea_level
method.description:
Returns the current sea level.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_sea_level]

method.name: set_seed
method.description:
Sets the random seed for deterministic voxel selection.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_seed[/code] - Seed value. Same seed = same biome distribution.
[b]Effect:[/b] Used for position-seeded hashing to determine which surface block is selected when multiple options exist.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_seed]

method.name: get_seed
method.description:
Returns the current seed.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_seed]

method.name: set_default_voxel
method.description:
Sets the default voxel type for fallback cases.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_voxel_id[/code] - Voxel type ID. Used when no biome matches.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_default_voxel]

method.name: get_default_voxel
method.description:
Returns the default voxel type.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_default_voxel]

method.name: set_blend_distance
method.description:
Sets the biome transition blend distance (blocks).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_distance[/code] - Distance (8-32 blocks). Controls smooth transition zone between biomes.
[b]Effect:[/b] Larger blend distance = softer transitions. Smaller = sharper boundaries.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] biome_gen.set_blend_distance(16) # Smooth transitions [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_blend_distance]

method.name: get_blend_distance
method.description:
Returns the blend distance.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_blend_distance]

method.name: add_biome
method.description:
Adds a biome with simple depth-based subsurface (deprecated method, use add_biome_with_y_ranges).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]name[/code] - Biome name (e.g., "grassland") [code]min_height, max_height[/code] - Height range where biome appears [code]min_temperature, max_temperature[/code] - Temperature range (-1 to 1) [code]min_humidity, max_humidity[/code] - Humidity range (-1 to 1) [code]surface_blocks[/code] - Array of voxel types for surface [code]subsurface_blocks[/code] - Array of voxel types for subsurface [code]depth[/code] - How many blocks deep subsurface layer is
[b]Note:[/b] This method is deprecated. Use [method add_biome_with_y_ranges] instead for better control over layering.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_biome_with_y_ranges]

method.name: add_biome_with_y_ranges
method.description:
Adds a biome with Y-range based subsurface layers (preferred method).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]name[/code] - Biome identifier [code]min_height, max_height[/code] - Altitude range [code]min_temperature, max_temperature[/code] - Climate range [code]min_humidity, max_humidity[/code] - Moisture range [code]surface_blocks[/code] - Array of voxel types for surface layer [code]subsurface_layers_array[/code] - Array of layer dictionaries with keys: - [code]"min_y"[/code] - Minimum Y coordinate for this layer - [code]"max_y"[/code] - Maximum Y coordinate for this layer - [code]"blocks"[/code] - Array of voxel types to use in this Y range [code]bedrock_block[/code] - Voxel type at world bottom [code]filler_block[/code] - Fallback block type
[b]Example:[/b] [code] biome_gen.add_biome_with_y_ranges( "mountain", 15.0, 30.0, # High altitude 0.3, 0.7, # Moderate temp 0.3, 0.7, # Moderate humidity [5], # Snow surface [ {\"min_y\": 5, \"max_y\": 10, \"blocks\": [6]}, # Rock layer {\"min_y\": -50, \"max_y\": 5, \"blocks\": [3]}, # Deep stone {\"min_y\": -100, \"max_y\": -50, \"blocks\": [7]} # Mineral layer ], 3, # bedrock 3 # filler ) [/code]
[b]Note:[/b] When Y-ranges overlap, the first registered layer wins (priority by registration order).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_biome], [method clear_biomes]

method.name: clear_biomes
method.description:
Removes all configured biomes.
[b]Effect:[/b] Clears biome list. After this, terrain will use default voxel type.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_count]

method.name: get_biome_count
method.description:
Returns the number of configured biomes.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_data]

method.name: get_biome_data
method.description:
Returns biome configuration as a dictionary.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]index[/code] - Biome index (0 to get_biome_count()-1)
[b]Return Value:[/b] Dictionary with keys: name, min_height, max_height, min_temperature, max_temperature, min_humidity, max_humidity, surface_blocks, subsurface_layers, bedrock_block, filler_block
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_count]

method.name: get_height_at
method.description:
Samples height at world position (X, Z).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, z[/code] - Horizontal position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Height value (Y coordinate of terrain surface at this location).
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_blended_height_at]

method.name: get_voxel_at
method.description:
Gets the voxel at world coordinates.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, y, z[/code] - Integer world position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] [Voxel] object with type and material info.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_voxel_at]

method.name: get_biome_index_at
method.description:
Gets the primary biome index at a location.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, z[/code] - Horizontal position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Biome index (0 to get_biome_count()-1).
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_blended_biome_weights]

method.name: get_blended_biome_weights
method.description:
Gets blended biome weights at a location (smooth transitions).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, z[/code] - Horizontal position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Array of {biome_index, weight} dictionaries representing contribution of each nearby biome.
[b]Effect:[/b] Used internally for smooth biome transitions. Biomes closer to blend_distance contribute more.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_index_at]

method.name: select_voxel_with_blending
method.description:
Selects a voxel type using blended biome weights.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, y, z[/code] - Position [code]biome_weights[/code] - Array from [method get_blended_biome_weights] [code]is_surface[/code] - true for surface blocks, false for subsurface
[b]Return Value:[/b] Voxel type ID to place.
[b]Note:[/b] Deterministic selection based on position and seed.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_blended_biome_weights]

method.name: get_blended_height_at
method.description:
Gets height blended across nearby biomes.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, z[/code] - Horizontal position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Blended height value (smooth transitions between biome heights).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_height_at]

method.name: get_temperature_at
method.description:
Samples temperature at position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Temperature value (-1 to 1).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_humidity_at]

method.name: get_humidity_at
method.description:
Samples humidity at position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Humidity value (-1 to 1).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_temperature_at]

method.name: select_block_deterministic
method.description:
Deterministically selects one block from an array.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, y, z[/code] - Position (used for seeding) [code]blocks[/code] - Array of voxel type IDs to choose from
[b]Return Value:[/b] One of the blocks in the array (deterministic based on position).
[b]Effect:[/b] Allows surface variety without randomness. Same position always selects same block.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_seed]

method.name: ensure_noise_generators
method.description:
Initializes default noise generators if not already set.
[b]Effect:[/b] Creates standard Perlin noise generators for height, temperature, humidity if they don't exist.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread (internally serialized).
[b]Note:[/b] Automatically called during generation if needed.
